remaining_limits: Cooperative NROs share the game process; scripts must yield and callbacks must return.
Raw pointers and third-party native code cannot be isolated from arbitrary plugin faults.
New or renamed assets still require Switch appearance, animation, LOD and collision tests.

audit_notes: Initial manager/config invocations used the returning sample instead of the documented looping template; final runs use the correct fixture and pass.
A mixed-batch regression initially supplied a model name that disagreed with its fixture filenames; corrected matching files pass.
The old smoke assertion required a button at its original scroll offset; revised checks verify clipped and scrolled bounds. Primary preparation actions were subsequently moved before advanced tools.
New packaging link validation caught old relative guide links; both root guides are normalized and final package links pass.
